Commentary.Commentary: The chase begins! The players have returned on the field. Philip Salt and Dawid Malan are the English openers. Shaheen Afridi to bowl first up...

Right then, it's a below-par total that Pakistan have managed on the board. They do have a quality bowling attack at their disposal but there are not enough runs on the board. Can they still push England in this game? Keep in mind that the English batting is fairly inexperienced and if Pakistan manage to claim a few early wickets, it could turn out to be a tight chase. Stay tuned, the run chase will begin shortly.

Needless to say that England were exceptional with the ball. Everyone managed to leave some mark with their bowling. Saqib was outstanding and so were Lewis Gregory and Craig Overton. Brydon Carse was wicketless but he bowled with good pace and looked like a real deal. The leggie, Matt Parkinson also had a good outing and picked up two, which also included the prized scalp of Fakhar Zaman. It was a nearly perfect outing for England in the field, nearly perfect because they dropped three catches. Otherwise, Ben Stokes will be really impressed with his boys at the moment.

It indeed was a great bowling show by Saqib Mahmood and it was good to read his thoughts. England will be thrilled with the way they bowled with their inexperienced unit. Mahmood set the tone very nicely by striking twice in his opening over. Imam, Babar and Rizwan were sent packing very early and the cream of the Pakistan batting was removed in a flash. Fakhar Zaman though batted with a lot of authority and played some extravagant shots. His partnership with Sohaib Maqsood tried to revive the innings but the unfortunate run out of the latter once again put the visitors off track. The biggest blow came to them in the form of Fakhar's wicket and after that, it went downhill. Shadab Khan's 30 helped them to get close to the 150-run mark but overall, it was a dismal show with the willow for the Asian team.

Saqib Mahmood is caught for a quick chat. The speedster says that the opportunity came in a weird way but they are hard to come by in this side so he is happy to take it the way he did in this match. Shares that he has bowled to the Pakistan batsmen in the PSL and got them out before so that gave him the confidence but likewise, they also knew about his bowling and in that way, it was an even playing field. Informs that there was a bit of movement with the new ball but as it got older, the pitch got better. Feels that they were lucky to have a good start and managed to keep the pressure. Mentions that getting an early wicket helps to settle down the nerves. Hopes they finish the job now with the bat.

OUT! This time Stokes is underneath it and he makes no mistake. Overton slants in a good length ball on middle, Shaheen once again chances his arms and attempts for a big heave-ho over mid-wicket. But he gets a big top edge and Stokes catches it with ease at mid off. PAKISTAN ARE ALL OUT FOR 141.
Commentary.Howout: c Ben Stokes b Craig Overton

Commentary.Commentary: DROPPED! Third catch put down in the field and probably the easiest. A length ball angling into the batsman, Shaheen aims to heave it over the leg side but gets a top edge. Matt Parkinson at long off runs across to his right but puts down a simple catch. They take two.
A well-directed bumper on this occasion, Afridi is caught in a tangle and fends it away off the outside half of his bat. It goes wide of backward point for a run.

Play and a miss! Short in length and on off, Shaheen attempts to play the ramp shot but misses. He has been leaving these deliveries thus far but with number 11 at the opposite end, he has decided to chance his arm.
A touch short in length on middle, Shaheen stands back and taps it down to mid-wicket. Rauf looks for a run but is sent back. Good call by Shaheen.
Carse goes short and on off, angling away, Shaheen leans back and lets it through to the keeper.
FOUR! Shaheen goes down the ground with mid on up in the circle. A delivery is pitched up around off, Shaheen clears his front leg and smashes it over mid on for a boundary.
On a length around middle and leg, Shaheen defends it back firmly to the bowler.
A very full ball is speared in around off, Rauf does well to keep it out safely towards mid off.
Overton angles in a good length ball on middle, Haris again blocks it from the crease.
Slants in a length ball on off, Rauf gets behind the line and defends it from the back foot.
Haris Rauf is the last batsman for Pakistan.

OUT! Pakistan are 9 down! Overton digs in a short ball on middle, Shadab takes on the challenge to play the pull shot but is probably a bit early into the shot. The lack of pace has undone him. It goes off the top edge to Dawid Malan who takes the catch easily at deep backward square leg. A handy knock by Shadab but it's not enough.
Commentary.Howout: c Dawid Malan b Craig Overton

Commentary.Commentary: A gentle push in the gap at covers for a run.
A touch short in length and outside off, Shadab runs it down to third man and takes a single.
Carse goes short and angles it away from around off, Shaheen leans back, removes his gloves from the line of the delivery, and allows it through.
Good length ball around leg, Shaheen stands back and defends it near his pads to the leg side.
Fuller in length and outside off, Afridi drives through the line but finds mid off.
Short in length and outside off, Khan dabs it down to third man for a run.
A length ball outside off, angling away, Shaheen stays back and strokes it through covers for one.
Short in length on off, Shadab pulls it behind square leg and collects a single.

Drinks break. England continue to roar in this match and have reduced Pakistan to 129/8. They are right on top and would be aiming to pick the remaining wickets quickly. Nothing has gone right for the visitors so far. They have flopped on a pitch which isn't too bad for batting. Can they somehow stretch their total close to 200? If they do that, they have the bowling attack to test the new-look batting unit of England. Brydon Carse to bowl after the break...
Returns to over the wicket for the final ball and angles away a length ball on off, Shaheen pushes it from the back foot to the mid off region.
A length ball on off, angling in, Shaheen presents a straight bat as he keeps it out safely on the leg side.
A well-directed bouncer, on middle, Shaheen keeps his eyes on the ball and arches back to let it go.
Wide! Slips a length ball down the leg side, Shaheen attempts to get a tickle behind it but misses.
Overton bends his back to bowl short around off, Afridi leans back and allows it through.
Sharp delivery, full and on middle, angling down, Afridi is beaten for pace as he fails to work it around. It goes off his pads to mid-wicket.
Starts from 'round the wicket and angles in a full ball on off, Afridi defends it off his front foot to the off side.
Bowling change. Craig Overton returns in action.
No fifer for Saqib Mahmood but still outstanding work done by him. A bouncer around off, Shadab lets it be. 10-1-42-4, his career-best figures.
Shortish and on off, Shadab goes back and taps it down to point. Right, one ball left for Saqib to get his fifer. Can he?
Pitches it up and on middle, Shadab brings down a straight bat and pushes it past the bowler. The mid on fielder makes the stop to his left.
Fine shot from a number 10 batsman. Fuller in length and outside off, Afridi doesn't try to hit it hard and just caresses it through covers for three runs.
Mahmood looks for a yorker but it's a full toss on off, Shadab drives it through cover-point for a run.
Angles in a full ball on off, Shadab covers the line and defends it back to the bowler.
Beaten all ends up! Loopy full ball landing full on off, Shaheen tries to defend but it spins past the outside edge.
Full and flighted outside off, Afridi leans forward and pushes it to covers.
Flatter and shorter on off, Shadab gets back and cuts it to deep cover for a run.
Shaheen Afridi is in next.

OUT! Hasan holes out! This was very predictive. Parkinson continues to toss it up and tempts the batsman. It's full and landing on middle, Ali decides to smoke it into the stands at mid-wicket but gets more height than distance on his shot. Dawid Malan is once again in the deep and he redeems himself by taking the skier safely.
Commentary.Howout: c Dawid Malan b Matt Parkinson

Commentary.Commentary: That is punched off the back foot, through point, for a single.
Aerial shot! Shadab has decided to attack the leggie. Full and around off, Khan goes down and lofts it over mid on. The fielder stops it just before the rope and they take a couple.
Identical to the last delivery, again Shadab plays it late and this time it's past the backward point fielder for a run.
A touch short in length on off, Shadab allows the ball to come and plays it late. Taps it to point.
IN THE AIR... Is this the fifer for Mahmood? Nopes. Short in length and outside off, Hasan top edges his attempted pull shot and it falls safely wide of third man. A single taken.
A length ball outside off, Hasan plays a strong punch through the line but finds the cover fielder.
Too full in length on off, Shadab squeezes it through point and collects a run.
Short in length on off, Shadab turns and pulls it over mid-wicket for a brace.

DROPPED AND FOUR! 14 from the over! Tossed up ball on middle, Hasan plays the slog sweep over mid-wicket, towards the longest part of the ground. Dawid Malan does the hard work to reach the chance but fails to hold on to the catch. It deflects off his palms and finds the fence. That's the second catch dropped off Parkinson's bowling.
Wide! Slips a full ball down the leg side, Ali swings his bat but misses.
Quicker through the air, flat and short on leg, it's punched down to long off for one.

SIX! This one has gone the distance. There is no point hanging in there, looking to survive. Loopy and full wide outside off, Shadab fetches it from there and dismisses it over long on. With the fielder up, that was a safe shot as well.
Loopy and full around leg, Shadab leans forward and tries to defend. Fails and it goes off his pads to square leg.
Advances down the track to a full ball and drills his drive back past the bowler for a run at long off.
Flatter and shorter on leg, Shadab goes back and punches it through covers for a run.
Swing and a miss! This comes naturally to Hasan Ali. He spots the width outside off and goes after it. Throws his bat but fails to connect.
Shortish and on off, Hasan stays on the back foot and defends it to covers.
A bouncer, the batsman ducks under that one.
Shortish and on off, punched off the back foot to covers.
Hasan Ali is the new batsman.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Back of a length delivery around off, angling in with some extra bounce, Faheem camps back to punch it through the line but the extra lift means that the outside edge is generated and John Simpson makes no mistake. Yet another wicket goes down and Saqib Mahmood is one away from a fifer now.
Commentary.Howout: c John Simpson b Saqib Mahmood

Commentary.Commentary: Shortish and on off, Shadab gets back and drops it on the off side for a run.
Goes on the back foot and steers it through point. 100 up for Pakistan, finally.
Floated and full outside off, Shadab plays a mistimed push to covers.
Fullish and on off, driven past the bowler to mid off.
Loopy one, full and around middle, Shadab defends it back with firm hands.
Fullish and on off, Shadab sweeps it down to fine leg for a couple.
Dropped? Full and flighted around off, spinning away, Shadab goes down for the slog sweep but fails to connect well. There seems to be some sound, maybe an under edge but the keeper fails to hold on.
Taps it down to point and takes a single. Shadab dives to complete it when there was no need.
Again a short ball and this time it's a more controlled pull shot to deep square leg. They cross.
Short in length and on off, Faheem is hurried into the pull shot but still plays it in front of square leg for two.
A touch short and on off, Ashraf defends it from the back foot to the leg side.
Angling into the batsman from around off, Faheem works it to the right of mid-wicket.
Shortish and on off, Shadab chops it down towards point for a brisk run.
Short and wide outside off, punched to sweeper cover for a brace.
Loopy one on off, Faheem is behind the line as he blocks.
Flatter and shorter on middle, Faheem goes back and punches it to mid-wicket.
Fuller and on off, defended to covers.
The batsman has just watchfully blocked this out.
Flighted and full on off, Faheem defends it off his front foot to covers.
Pitches it up and around off, straightening off the seam, Shadab is squared up as he pushes it aerially towards mid off.
The batsman has just blocked that from his crease.
Short and wide outside off, there to be hit, Shadab cuts but finds the point fielder.
Full and angling in on middle, Shadab stays back and pushes it defensively to mid on.
That is defended solidly off the front foot.
Saqib Mahmood is back on. Ben Stokes is going for the kill.
A yorker-length ball on off, Shadab digs it out safely to the off side.
Tossed up ball landing full on off, Faheem calmly defends it off his front foot.
Faheem Ashraf walks in next.

OUT! Soft dismissal for Fakhar Zaman. First time Parkinson misses his length and is rewarded with a wicket. A leg spinner's special. This breed always gets success with a long hop. It's outside off and Fakhar moves back to unfurl the square cut. But he fails to middle his shot properly and edges it towards point. Zak Crawley stands tall in that region and catches the ball over his head, with a little jump. Pakistan are 6 down for 90 and they have now lost their best batter.
Commentary.Howout: c Zak Crawley b Matt Parkinson

Commentary.Commentary: Floated one, full and on off, Fakhar leans forward and defends it.
Slower through the air, short and on off, once again Shadab gets back and this time he pushes it to the right side of point for a run.
A bit short and on off, Shadab moves back inside the crease and keeps it out to point.
Slow loopy full ball on middle, Shadab draws forward and defends it to covers.
Around off, on a fuller length, Fakhar pushes it off his front foot to mid off. 6 from Stokes' first over.
Stokes keeps it fuller and outside off, Shadab drives it with the toe end of his bat to covers. They take a run.
Full again, on off, Shadab is on the front foot as he defends it back to the bowler.
Fullish and on middle, driven back to the bowler who failed to make the stop and deflected it behind the stumps. The batsmen crossed.
Fuller in length and on middle, Zaman flicks it through square leg for a couple of runs.
Dot off the Free Hit! An off pace delivery, short and outside off, Fakhar plays a mistimed punch towards mid off.
Starts with a short delivery outside off, Shadab goes on the back foot and cuts it off the outer half to third man for a run. It's called a no ball for overstepping. Free Hit coming up...
Ben Stokes brings himself into the attack much to the delight of the crowd.
Floated ball outside off, Zaman tries to tap and run by pushing it to point but it's not on.
Floated and full on middle, it's defended back to the bowler.
Tossed up ball outside off, Fakhar is on the front foot as he drives it to short cover.
That is defended solidly off the front foot.
Leans forward to a full ball and drives it in the gap at covers for one.
Loopy and full ball around leg, skidding down, Shadab tries to defend but misses and is hit on the pads, although outside the line.
Edgy! Fuller in length and outside off, Zaman drives it off the thickish edge to deep backward point. Two taken.
Good length ball on off, Fakhar stays on the back foot and defends it.
Wide! A bouncer down the leg side, Fakhar leaves it alone.
Again there is some miscommunication. A back of a length ball on off, Zaman punches it to covers. Shadab is out responding to a call for a run but then returns.
Shadab Khan is the new batsman.

OUT! Sohaib Maqsood is run out! What a sorry end to this good-looking partnership. A very full ball on middle, Fakhar digs it out towards mid on and comes rushing forward a run. Sohaib Maqsood responds but then to his shock, Fakhar stops. He looks at the mid-wicket fielder charging at the ball and just stops. Maqsood has to turn and go back but before he could do that, James Vince collects the ball running across from mid-wicket, charges towards the non-striker's end and then scores a direct hit. Sohaib is not even in the picture. He is given out by the on-field umpire and returns with a dejected face. Pakistan have now lost half their side.
The batsman has just blocked that from his crease.

FOUR! The 50-run stand comes up with a beautiful shot! Fuller in length and on middle, Zaman plays a controlled flick shot and picks the gap at mid-wicket for a boundary. This pair has steadied things for Pakistan after a forgetful start.
Fuller and on middle, Sohaib takes his front leg forward and drives it back to the bowler.
Nice drift on this delivery, full and around leg, Sohaib defends it back with a straight bat.
The line is a little too straight from Parkinson and Fakhar works it through square leg for one.
Tossed up ball on middle, slightly short again, Maqsood hangs back and punches it down to long on for a run.
A touch short and around off, Fakhar gets back and punches it towards the bowler. Matt dives to his left and palms it to mid-wicket to give away a single.
Loopy and full around off, Zaman is on the front foot as he defends it to the off side.
Change in bowling and it's time for some spin. Matt Parkinson to have a go now.
Short in length and outside off, Sohaib crouches a bit and lets it be. The dry period for Pakistan continues.
Some extra bounce again for Carse to trouble the batsman. Sohaib tries to work it around but misses and is hit on the thigh pad.
Carse goes full and on middle, it's flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Short in length around off, Fakhar covers the line and defends it towards mid off.
Slightly short and outside off, Sohaib throws his bat at it and edges it down to third man for a run.
Short in length on off, some extra bounce, Maqsood goes on his toes and defends it to the leg side.

DRINKS! It has been a fantastic start for this young and inexperienced England team. They have been all over Pakistan with the ball so far and will look to continue their impressive start. Fakhar Zaman was stranded as he saw partners come and go at the other end. Sohaib Maqsood though has done well so far as the pair has steadied the ship. The job though is nowhere close to done as they need to carry on.
A touch short and close to off, 79 mph, Fakhar defends it from the back foot to the leg side. 6 runs in the last three overs, England have put on a choke here.
An 83 mph delivery, full and on off, angling in, Zaman defends it late, back towards the bowler.
A mistimed shot! Short in length and on off, Zaman plays a reactive pull shot without any timing. It flies in the air but goes safely wide of mid on. They take two.
Back of a length ball on off, Sohaib jumps and works it towards square leg for one.
Identical to the last delivery, it's angling in towards off, Sohaib stays back and gently pushes it to point.
Good length ball on off, angling in, Maqsood plays it late and pats it down to backward point.
On off, Zaman defends it to see off the over.

Uppish but safe! Full on middle, Sohaib Maaqsood drives it uppishly to the left of Crase. He gets his fingers on it but cannot hold onto it. They take a run as the ball goes behind. Technically a dropped catch but it's too harsh to call it that way.
Carse continues to hit the deck hard. Maqsood is happy to take his time and block this.
Good length ball on middle, Maqsood defends it back to Carse.
Shortish ball on middle and off. Zaman pulls it in a controlled manner to deep square leg for a single.

Back of a length ball on middle and leg. It hurries onto Fakhar Zaman. He looks to play it to the on side but gets an inside edge onto the body. The ball goes to the off side and he thinks of a run but Maqsood does not feel it is worth the risk.
Length ball around off, Maqsood taps it to point to see off the over. Just a solitary run off it.
Bouncer! It is around the body, Maqsood sees it early and ducks under it.
Back of a length ball on off. Maqsood hops and taps it onto the ground on the off side. Does well to deal with the extra bounce.
Full around off, Maqsood pushes his drive to mid off.
Slightly shorter on off. Maqsood defends it with a straight bat.
Good length ball on off, Fakhar Zaman tucks it to the on side for one.
Full toss. Sohaib Maqsood misses out this time. He drives it but straight to the man at short extra cover.

SIX! WOW! That is some shot! He is a reputed hitter in the Pakistan cricket circuit and now he is showing it at the international stage. Shortish ball outside off, Maqsood stays leg side of the ball and slams it over covers for a biggie. Not an easy shot to play but we have seen him do that in the Pakistan Super League on a consistent basis.
This time Carse goes full on the stumps. Maqsood defends it and shouts a loud no.
Spicy ball from Carse! Good length ball pitching on off and it comes back in with a sharp pace. It hurries Maqsood. He hops and looks to defend but misses and gets hit on the body.
Good running! Full ball on middle and leg, Fakhar taps it to mid on. The fielder there is at the edge of the circle. Fakhar sees an opportunity to take the single and takes it with ease.
Good length delivery on top of off. Fakhar blocks it.
Length ball around off, Maqsood punches it with little intent to covers.
On the stumps, Maqsood keeps it out.
On the pads, Maqsood tucks it through mid-wicket for a brace.
FOUR! This is some response! Overpitched on middle, Maqsood shows his class as he gets behind it and drives it beautifully past the bowler for a boundary.
Lovely ball! Overton hits the deck hard on off and gets it to shape away slightly, Maqsood looks to play but gets beaten. No footwork. That's the line and length for Overton.
Fullish on off, Maqsood pushes it to covers.
Good length ball on off, Fakahr defends it with a straight bat. 5 runs off Carse's first over.
Carse pulls his length back slightly. Fakhar pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Slightly overpitched on middle, Fakhar drives it straight as an arrow past the bowler for a boundary.
Fuller on off, Fakhar pushes it to covers.
Good length ball on off, Fakhar defends it with a straight bat.
Carse starts with a very full delivery on off. Maqsood runs it down to third man off the outside edge for a single.
Powerplay 2 signalled. Now 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. Here comes the debutant, Brydon Carse into the attack.
Overton lands it full and on middle, Fakhar defends it with soft hands to mid-wicket. Powerplay 1 comes to a close and England have dominated it thoroughly - 46/4!
The batter comes forward and plays the off drive but it is a dot ball as the ball goes straight to mid off.

FOUR! Fakhar Zaman is liking this length and gentle pace of Overton. Fetches a short delivery from outside off and pummels his pull shot through mid-wicket for a cracking boundary. A man is dropped back now.
Craig goes fuller and on off, Fakhar pushes it off his front foot to mid off.
FOUR! Fast hands of Fakhar Zaman on display here. Short in length again from Overton, around off, Zaman swivels a bit on the back foot and pulls it thunderously to the deep mid-wicket fence.
Starts his spell with a short delivery outside off, Fakhar rocks back to cut it through the line but fails to middle his shot. It takes the bottom edge and rolls to cover-point.
Change in bowling. First one of the game and it sees Craig Overton come into the attack.
Fuller in length and outside off, Fakhar drives it with gentle hands towards extra cover. The fielder is at the edge of the circle and it's an easy single for Zaman.
Angling in from a length around off, Zaman turns it on the leg side, looks for a run but then returns as the mid on fielder quickly reaches the ball.
Too full and on off, yet another glorious drive from the bat of Fakhar but he finds the mid off fielder this time.
FOUR! Zaman is in good form and showing that there is no demon on this surface. Saqib goes from 'round the wicket and delivers it full around off, Fakhar drives it smartly through wide mid off.
Good length delivery outside off, Maqsood opens the face of the bat late and steers it down to third man for a single.
Lands it full and outside off, Maqsood drives but finds the extra cover fielder. England won't mind him driving with three slips waiting for an outside edge.

FOUR! What a shot! Fakhar Zaman throws his hands at it and nails it through the gap. Fuller in length and outside off, Fakhar drills it through the line and pierces the gap between silly mid off and extra cover for a boundary.
Fullish ball on middle, Sohaib drives it dead straight and it collides with the stumps at the other end. The ball deflects to wide mid on and they cross.
Zaman drives again, finds the gap at covers and crosses for a single.
Pitches it up and outside off, Zaman drives it crisply through the line but finds the extra cover fielder.
A length ball on off, angling away, Zaman goes on the back foot and defends it towards silly mid off.
Fuller in length on middle, Fakhar drives it back firmly and the bowler deflects it towards mid on.
The new man in is Sohaib Maqsood.

OUT! The debutant departs. Saqib steams in from 'round the wicket and angles in a length ball on off, Shakeel moves across a bit and then tries to defend but misses. He is pinged on the front pad, they appeal vociferously and this time the finger has gone up. Saud walks up to his partner and then takes the DRS. Ultra Edge detects no wood and Ball Tracker shows that it's the umpire's call as the ball is clipping the top of the middle stump. This has been a brilliant spell of bowling from Mahmood and Pakistan are in all sorts of bother.
Saud Shakeel has been adjudged LBW but he has decided to review it. Let's see whether technology comes to his rescue.

A very muted appeal from the bowler for an lbw. It dies down quickly, reason - there was an inside edge. A length ball outside off, shaping in, Shakeel tries to defend but it takes the inside edge and strikes him on the pads.
Identical to the last delivery, once again the debutant is content in blocking it from the back foot.
Saqib Mahmood switches to 'round the wicket for the southpaw and angles in a good length ball on off, Shakeel stands back and defends it down.
Back of a length delivery on middle and off, Fakhar opens the face of his bat late and guides it to third man for a run.
A length delivery around middle and off, Shakeel walks across the stumps and works it off his pads behind square leg. The call is for two but he will get only a run.

The bowler keeps it full and straight, Fakhar forces it back to the bowler who gets his right hand on it and makes a half stop. Maybe, Gregory was looking for a run out at the non-striker's end as Saud was outside the crease. Anyway, no harm done to Pakistan.
A lovely flowing drive from the bat of Fakhar as he connects from the middle of the bat but he finds the fielder at extra cover.
Lewis returns to bowl very full, around off, Fakhar drives it off his front foot to mid off.
Width on offer outside off, short in length, Fakhar cracks it square of the wicket on the off side. The third man fielder cuts it off to his left and they take a couple.
This time the bowler pulls his length back a bit and delivers it on middle and off, Fakhar moves back and defends it towards the bowler.
Gregory pitches it up and outside off, Zaman is on the front foot as he pushes it towards mid off.
On the stumps, Saud Shakeel defends it with a straight bat to see off the over.
On middle and leg, Shakeel taps it to the on side.
Mahmood pulls his length back and bowls it on off. Saud defends it.

FOUR! Saud Shakeel is off the mark in ODI with a boundary! Full on the pads, Shakeel says thank you very much. He flicks it through square leg, away from the fielder inside the circle and gets a boundary.

Almost dragged on! Good length delivery around off. It comes back in. Fakhar looks to play but then decides to leave it. Too late as the ball hits the inside edge of the bat. Luckily for Zaman, it misses the stumps and goes to fine leg, allowing him to get off the firing line.
Shortish ball on middle, Fakhar defends it with a straight bat.
Good length ball around off, Shakeel shuffles and defends it with a straight bat to see off the over.
This one nips in a bit. Shakeel does well to tuck it to the on side.
Full on middle, Shakeel defends it.
Back of a length ball outside off, Shakeel taps it to the off side.
Pakistan in tatters after losing the cream of their batting. And what a moment for the debutant, Saud Shakeel to walk in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust and this time it is the man in form, Mohammad Rizwan. Once again it is an impeccable delivery and Gregory gets his first wicket in ODIs. Fullish ball on off, Rizwan looks to play it through mid on hoping the ball to nip back in. This one though holds up and keeps its line. It kisses the outside edge of Rizwan's willow and goes low to the keeper. John Simpson takes his first catch in ODI cricket. Pakistan are 3 down in the 4th over. Horror start for the visitors.
Commentary.Howout: c John Simpson b Lewis Gregory

Commentary.Commentary: Full on middle and off, Fakhar clips it with the swing through wide mid on. He does not time it right off the meat. Hence the ball does not have the legs to reach the fence. Three taken.

EDGED AND FOUR! Another streaky boundary for Rizwan. Good length ball around off, Rizwan looks to play it to the off side with a horizontal bat. The ball shapes in and catches the inside edge. Luck is going Mohammad Rizwan's way as it goes past the stumps and fine down to the fine leg fence.
Fakhar Zaman is off the mark! Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Fakhar tucks it to the left of mid on and takes a single.
Smart cricket this. Follows the boundary with a single towards point.

FOUR! Excellent shot! This man is in great form and this shot is a testament to that. Slightly overpitched outside off, Rizwan is quick to pounce on that mistake. He gets on his front foot and crunches it through covers for a boundary.
Mahmood hits the deck hard around off. Rizwan taps it towards mid on.
Back of a length delivery around off, Rizwan hops and taps it to point.
Maiden from Lewis Gregory to begin with. This is a solid start from the hosts. The last ball is on the stumps, Fakhar is happy to block it and see off Lewis Gregory's first over.

Appeal for LBW but this is pitched outside leg so skipper Stokes does not bother asking any questions. Good length ball pitching outside leg and coming in with the angle. Fakhar looks to defend but misses and gets hit on the pad. Lewis Gregory goes up in an appeal but not with much support.
Full on middle and off, Fakhar keeps it out with a straight bat.
Fuller on the pads, Zaman defends it.
On the pads and swinging into the left-hander. Fakhar looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Gregory starts with a fullish ball on middle and leg, Fakhar defends it to begin his innings.
Who will bowl from the other end with the second new ball? Debutant Lewis Gregory to speed in...

EDGED AND FOUR! Pakistan finally get off the mark but what a supreme over to begin with from Saqib Mahmood. Good length ball outside off, Rizwan looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge. Luckily for him, it goes well past the army of slips behind and to the third man fence.
Back of a length delivery on middle, Rizwan hops and blocks it.
Good length ball outside off, Rizwan leaves it alone.
A great start from new-look England. Two wickets in the first three balls. In walks Mohammad Rizwan. Three slips in place.

OUT! CAUGHT! Superstar, skipper, and Pakistan's talisman, Babar Azam is out of here without even troubling the scorer. What a dream start it is for this young English side and Saqib Mahmood. Fantastic delivery from Saqib Mahmood. He bowls it in the channel of uncertainty around off. Babar has a poke at it but the ball shapes away and catches the outside edge. It falls on its way to second slip. Zak Crawley, on his ODI debut, shows his Test match catching skills. He bends and takes a very good low catch. A shocking start for Pakistan.
Commentary.Howout: c Zak Crawley b Saqib Mahmood

Commentary.Commentary: Full ball on middle and off, Azam looks to drive to begin with but gets an inside edge which sees the ball go to mid-wicket.
Superstar Babar Azam walks in early to the crease.

DRS time straightaway. It's a huge shout for an lbw against Imam. The umpire has turned it down and Ben Stokes decides to review it. Pitching seems to be an issue here. Hang on, it's pitching in line and the ball is going on to hit the stumps. Early strike for England.

OUT! LBW! Saqib Mahmood, Stokes, and England start with a bang! Mahmood starts right on the money. He bowls a fullish ball pitching on leg and coming in a bit. Imam-ul-Haq looks to flick but gets beaten by the movement. It hits him right on the front pad. A huge appeal follows but the umpire is no keen. Stokes has a word with the bowler and the keeper and decides to take the review. Replay rolls in and Ultra Edge shows no bat. Time for the Ball Tracker. It rolls in and shows three reds. The ball has pitched just in line with the leg stump  England get the ball rolling in style.

It's time to get going now! The spectators are allowed and that makes the atmosphere superb. Ben Stokes leads his troops onto the field. Out comes Imam-ul-Haq and Fakhar Zaman to open for Pakistan. Saqib Mahmood to kickoff proceedings with the first new ball. Two slips in place. Here we go...
Pakistan (Playing XI) - Fakhar Zaman, Imam-ul-Haq, Babar Azam (C), Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Saud Shakeel (On debut), Sohaib Maqsood, Shadab Khan, Faheem Ashraf, Hasan Ali, Shaheen Afridi, Haris Rauf.

England (Playing XI) - Philip Salt (On debut), Dawid Malan, Zak Crawley (On debut), James Vince, Ben Stokes (C), John Simpson (WK) (On debut), Lewis Gregory (On debut), Craig Overton, Brydon Carse (On debut), Saqib Mahmood, Matthew Parkinson.
Toss - The two captains are out in the middle, up goes the coin, Babar Azam calls it incorrectly and ENGLAND WILL BOWL!

The fresh image from the ground shows that the English players have formed a ring and several ODI caps are to be given. How many? We will let you know soon. Right then, if social media updates are to be believed, five English players have been handed their caps - Carse, Crawley, Gregory, Salt and Simpson. We will get the confirmation at the toss which is only a few minutes away. Stay tuned...

A few stumbling blocks before the start of the series but the ECB found a way and luckily the series will go as planned. Hello and welcome everyone to the first ODI of the 3-match series between England and Pakistan. It is not a full-strength England side but it is a great opportunity for the hosts to test their bench strength under a new leader in Ben Stokes. The hosts will still be looking to get another series win in their pocket and continue their impressive summer with the white ball. On the other hand, Pakistan will be eager to avenge their ODI series loss against England in 2019. Babar Azam and co. will look to put this inexperienced side to the sword and start their brief tour with a win. But one can never be sure which Pakistan turns up on the day as they are the most unpredictable side in world cricket. An exciting clash awaits us at the Sophia Garden, Cardiff. Can Stokes get off his ODI captaincy regime to a winnings start or will Pakistan spoil the party for Stokes and his young team? Stay tuned for toss and further updates.
